-- Match 5 (Aria id=1 vs Tino id=6): set as mutual like so Tino can test the reveal flow
UPDATE matches SET user1Liked = 1, user2Liked = 1, status = 'mutual' WHERE id = 5;

-- Match 1 (Jordan id=2 vs Tino id=6): keep as knocked so Tino can test the like flow from scratch
-- Match 2 (Sam id=3 vs Tino id=6): set Sam has already liked Tino, so when Tino likes back it becomes mutual
UPDATE matches SET user1Liked = 1, status = 'knocked' WHERE id = 2;

-- Seed some chat messages for match 5 (Aria + Tino) so chat isn't empty
INSERT INTO messages (matchId, senderId, content, filtered, createdAt)
VALUES
  (5, 1, 'Hey there 👋 I knocked on your profile!', 0, DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)),
  (5, 6, 'Hi Aria! I noticed you too 💜', 0, DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 8 MINUTE)),
  (5, 1, 'This is so mysterious... I love it 😄', 0, DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MINUTE)),
  (5, 6, 'Right? The anonymity makes it exciting', 0, DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 4 MINUTE)),
  (5, 1, 'I think we have a mutual connection... 💙', 0, DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 MINUTE));

-- Seed a message for match 1 (Jordan) so it shows in recent connections
INSERT INTO messages (matchId, senderId, content, filtered, createdAt)
VALUES
  (1, 2, 'Hey, I knocked on you! 💜', 0, DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE));
